author: Lyandres, Semion
title: The Bolsheviks' "German Gold" Revisited: An Inquiry into the 1917 Accusations
publisher: The Carl Beck Papers in Russian and East European Studies 1106, Center for Russian and East European Studies, University of Pittsburgh
notes: A documentary re-examination of the evidence on which the Provisional Government accused the Bolsheviks of taking German money in July 1917. Open access, and one of only two works in this pack's bibliography whose full text can actually be read from here — which is why it carries page numbers where the others do not.
